title: runtime (17.7.0): three server-side defects seen from a metadata app — hook refusals reach users with an internal prefix, `?top=0` answers `total: 0`, and `security/explain` allows updates the write door refuses
body:
Filing class: ① product defects — reach: public doors, each measured once on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0. Folded into one checklist card under the per-fire filing cap; triage may split it. Maintainer instruction for platform problems found in the hotclm browser test, verbatim, 2026-10-10: 「你遇到的平台问题应该提交issue」.

**Reader:** objectstack triage.

**Source:** `objectstack-ai/hotclm` full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotclm#87 — `main` @ `c31c7e2`; full report on #87 and in `qa/browser-test-17-7/REPORT.md` on branch `claude/issue-87-browser-test-17-7` (screenshots by number in `qa/browser-test-17-7/screenshots/`).

## Checklist

- [ ] **1. A hook's business refusal reaches the user with the platform's internal prefix.** A `beforeUpdate` hook that throws `Error('1 deviation(s) are still open; decide each one before the contract enters approval.')`, reached through `POST /api/v1/actions/clm_contract/send_for_approval`, toasts `hook 'contract_state_machine' threw: Error: 1 deviation(s) are still open; …` (`053`; same for "A current clean version is required before signing.", `077`). The app's sentence is the user-facing part; `hook '…' threw: Error:` is not. Nearest prior: #17265 (closed — the refusal answered `500` with no toast).
- [ ] **2. `GET /api/v1/data/clm_contract?top=0` answers `{"total":0}`** while `?top=1` answers `{"total":122}`. The Console issues this `top=0` probe on every list page, so any count read that way is wrong.
- [ ] **3. `POST /api/v1/security/explain` (update) answers `allowed: true` where the data door refuses.** (a) A Records Manager whose row-level policy starts at `signing`: explain allows update on an `approved` contract that `GET /api/v1/data/clm_contract/ID` answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for the same caller. (b) A `clm_admin` holder whose permission set carries no update RLS policy on the object (17.5 fails closed): explain allows, `PATCH` answers `403 "You do not have access to this record"`. This looks like another member of the open explain-vs-door family (#22571, and #22514 / #22550 / #22530 closed) — triage may fold it there.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo: `hook threw error prefix shown to user toast internal message` → 2 hits (#21596, #17265 — closed, not the prefix) · `top=0 returns total 0 count query data route` → 0 hits (control: the explain query on the same tool returned 56) · `security explain allowed true but write denied row-level security update` → 56 hits, the family above, none covering the fail-closed-no-update-policy or read-invisible-row update cases.

---
_Filed by the `repo:hotclm` PM seat from a measured browser pass._
